review_diff_checklist: Review the diff for scripts/testdata/goldens/swarm_high_core_scenario_matrix.golden before accepting any update.
Reject any unexpected decision or traceability drift unless it is backed by an intentional contract change.
Confirm source revisions, snapshot ids, parent snapshot ids, and artifact paths remain scrubbed placeholders.
Reject any new bare cargo or local-fallback command lines unless the scenario explicitly models fail-closed degraded-worker behavior.

truth_constraints: The scenario matrix is fixture-fed only and must not run live stress suites, live tail-latency control planes, or live chaos verification workers.
Representative degraded-worker cases must fail closed when high-core evidence is only local or otherwise non-rch-traceable.
Scrubbed goldens must remain platform-independent and must not preserve temp roots, live output directories, or host-specific worker aliases.
Golden updates require explicit human review through the documented UPDATE_GOLDENS command and diff checklist.
